name: Butterfree (CobbleEffort form)
look: violet wings with dark veins and yellow warning spots, a plum body and yellow eyes
entry: Its wings shine violet and gold so no predator forgets them: one taste of their scales leaves a bird Pokémon numb for days. Flocks of them drift over jungle canopies, and the trees they rest in turn faintly purple.
how: Wild: rare in jungles and flower forests.
